_readme: The sources every DMA producer binds to. Checked into the repo so an
agent cannot lose them between sessions, and so 'which template?' has
one answer that is reviewable in a diff rather than remembered.
Owner instruction, 2026-09-03: 'ensure all agents bind to the correct
template and also use the most recent version of the workbook copy
pasted on to the client folder', and 'use the Golden 1 CU examples as
the templated examples. Ensure there is a way to ensure the agents do
The measured column is the point. A template is not correct because it
is named 'template' — it is correct when it carries the tabs the app
reads. `scripts/check_template.py` measures any workbook against the
worker's own `_TAB_TARGET` map (29 tabs, each bound to the surface it
feeds) and prints what starves. Run it before synthesis, not after.

_why: Until the template is readable these are what 'correct' looks like,
and they are better evidence than a template anyway: they are real
packages that produced a promoted, six-page client surface.

rules: Bind to the template named above, not to whatever workbook is already in the client folder.

One workbook and one report per client folder. Copies belong outside the intake tree — the scan now ignores memory-backup/, archive/, old/ and their siblings, and among equal-ranked candidates reads the most recently modified.
Run check_template.py on the workbook BEFORE synthesis. A workbook carrying fewer than the reference's read-tabs will render empty states no producer can fill.
Never hand-edit a promoted workbook. Re-ingest is idempotent on an unchanged tree, so an edit that changes no checksum changes nothing.
